_readme: Optional. Drop this in a site folder as site.config.json to override DevTools defaults. Everything here is optional — delete keys you don't need.
_type_help: static | php | nodejs | fastapi. Auto-detected if omitted: package.json=nodejs, requirements.txt/main.py=fastapi, *.php=php, else static.
_app_help: fastapi only: ASGI target like "main:app". Auto-detected if omitted.
_router_help: php only: path to a router script (e.g. router.php). Auto-used if a router.php exists.
_start_help: nodejs/fastapi: run this exact command instead of the default (runs in the site folder, shell).
